criteria.text: Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 22 April 2028 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 22 October 2032 (72 months after Closing).
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $2,600,000 (2 x ($5,300,000 - $4,000,000), subject to the $5,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $2,200,000 is wrong.
Explains how 'material adverse effect' could be read narrowly or broadly and what each reading means for the Buyer's walk-away right.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $2,600,000 and the Seller's $2,200,000.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
